svg.title: Nobs Light wiring diagram
svg.text: 6 encoders with push · 2 ON-OFF-ON toggles · status LED · every D and A pin used
CONTROLS BESIDE THEIR PINS · USB UP · ANALOG HEADER ON THE LEFT
• Pins follow arduino-esp-32-wiring.md. SW1 is the one control split across both headers: pin 1 goes to A7, pin 3 to D1
• The LED is on B0 because every D and A pin is taken. Leave B1 unconnected: pulling it to GND stops the board from booting.
